name: Shanda
summary: Shanda is a night elf priestess and mentor located within the hollow trunk of Aldrassil in Shadowglen. Serving the Sisterhood of Elune, she instructs novice night elf priests in the fundamental prayers, wards, and rites of the Moon Goddess. Her guidance helps fledgling acolytes balance the light of Elune with their duties in defending Teldrassil.

sections.title: Acolyte of the Moon Mother
sections.body: Standing within the tranquil sanctuary of Aldrassil, Shanda serves as one of the first spiritual guides for young night elves dedicated to Elune. While the druids tend to the waking roots and boughs of Teldrassil, priestesses like Shanda ensure that the spiritual heart of the Kaldorei remains tethered to the White Lady. She instructs new initiates on channeling lunar grace for healing and protective wards, preparing them to face the corruption creeping into the boughs of the World Tree.

sections.title: Guiding New Initiates
sections.body: When young priests awaken to their calling in Shadowglen, they are directed to Shanda to prove their devotion and learn their first prayers. Through rites such as In Favor of Elune, she tests their resolve and provides them with blessed regalia and basic incantations. Under her tutelage, students learn that a priestess of the Kaldorei must be both a gentle hand to the wounded and a steadfast shield against the shadows.

faq.answer: Shanda is a night elf priest trainer located inside Aldrassil, the central hollow tree settlement of Shadowglen in Teldrassil. She instructs newly awakened night elf priests in the teachings of the Sisterhood of Elune.

faq.q: What role does Shanda play for new priests?
faq.answer: She introduces novice priests to basic prayers, curative spells, and protective magic gifted by Elune. New priests bring their Hallowed Sigil to her, and she sends them to the next stage of their training through In Favor of Elune.
Shanda is found on the ground level inside the hollow trunk of Aldrassil, the massive tree that serves as the starter hub in Shadowglen on Teldrassil.

faq.q: What organization does Shanda belong to?
aliases: is shanda a priestess of the moon
faq.answer: Shanda is a member of the Sisterhood of Elune, the ancient religious order of night elf priestesses that has guided Kaldorei spiritual and cultural life for thousands of years.

angles.text: For night elf priests starting their journey in Shadowglen, Shanda is the very first mentor to offer sacred words and guidance in Elune's grace.
Shanda represents the enduring tradition of the Sisterhood of Elune, tending to the spiritual well-being of the Kaldorei youth as they take their first steps on Teldrassil.
